ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) has commenced commercial operations at its new 4.4 million BL malt distillery in Telangana, representing a key strategic move for vertical integration and expanded domestic production. This backward integration is expected to significantly enhance operating margins, ensure consistent quality and supply for its whisky portfolio, and lay the groundwork for future product development, including a homegrown single malt whisky, with no apparent red flags highlighted in the announcement.
